questions.question: When Paul gave Timothy a solemn charge, what did he say Christ Jesus will do?

answers.text: Judge the living and the dead
Send a new prophet to Israel

questions.question: Paul warned Timothy that people would not tolerate sound doctrine. What would they do instead?

answers.text: Gather teachers to suit their own desires
Stop listening to any teachers at all
Leave the cities and go live alone

questions.question: Paul told Timothy he had fought the good fight and finished the race. What was he saying about his life?

answers.text: He stayed faithful all the way to the end
He wishes he had done much more for God
He is ready to start his work all over
